description: For a company that wants to use Loker Dollar job, talent or market data commercially or in bulk (beyond the free per-IP limits). Sends the request to a person at Loker Dollar, who replies to the work email within one business day. Requires a work email on the company domain (personal webmail is rejected). Only call this when the user asks for it and supplied these details. Self-serve paid access per call is on Apify (see paid_access.url).

use_case.description: What the company wants to build or do with the data (max 1000 chars).

volume.description: Optional expected volume, e.g. '50k job rows/month' or '200 talent searches/month'.

work_email.description: Work email on the company domain; the reply goes here.
